about: What the VPS should look like, read off the repository (docs/SERVER.md, scripts/deploy/Caddyfile, site/server.js, voice/README.md, the Install scripts). scripts/vps/Check-ProdParity.ps1 compares Get-ProdFacts.ps1 output against it. Issue #2165. No secret belongs here.

listeners.why: Caddy HTTP/3 (QUIC) on the same 443 door; Caddy opens it by default next to tcp 443

Windows SMB, part of the OS; shut from outside (Claude, Oct 11 run)
Windows Time (NTP client), part of the OS

tasks.name: Thornswood Watch
tasks.why: Watch-Services.ps1 -Install, every five minutes as SYSTEM, by design: it restarts and reads services and tasks of every other account (#2578, docs/DEPLOY-IDENTITIES.md section 8)

tasks.name: Thornswood Backup

tasks.name: Thornswood Load
tasks.why: scripts/vps/Watch-Load.ps1 -Install, every five minutes as SYSTEM (#2061), by design: it reads the processes of every other account (docs/DEPLOY-IDENTITIES.md section 8)

tasks.name: Thornswood Disk History
tasks.why: scripts/vps/Forecast-Storage.ps1 -Install, one disk sample a day at 04:00 as SYSTEM, and the forecast told to staff when it turns (#2178), by design: it writes into the watchdog's folder and outbox (docs/DEPLOY-IDENTITIES.md section 8)

tasks.name: Thornswood Runner Logs
tasks.why: scripts/vps/Keep-RunnerLogs.ps1 -Install, daily at 4:30 AM as SYSTEM (#3184), by design: it removes old logs from every runner account's _diag folder (docs/DEPLOY-IDENTITIES.md section 8)

tasks.name: Thornswood Bridge
